ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ كٓهيعٓصٓ
en: (1) Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.[806]
enNotes: [806]- See footnote to 2:1.
tr: Kāf hā yā ʿayn ṣād

ar: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
en: (2) [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
tr: Dhikru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahū zakariyyā

ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
en: (3) When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
tr: Idh nādā rabbahū nidāʾan khafiyyā

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
en: (4) He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled[807] with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
enNotes: [807]- Literally, "ignited." The spread of white hair throughout the head is likened to that of fire in the bush.
tr: Qāla rabbi innī wahanal-ʿaẓmu minnī washtaʿalar-raʾsu shaybaw walam akum biduʿāʾika rabbi shaqiyyā

ar: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
en: (5) And indeed, I fear the successors[808] after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
enNotes: [808]- Those relatives from the father's side who would inherit religious authority.
tr: Waʾinnī khiftul-mawāliya miw warāʾī wakānatimraʾatī ʿāqiran fahab lī mil ladunka waliyyā

ar: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
en: (6) Who will inherit me[809] and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
enNotes: [809]- Inherit from me religious knowledge and prophethood.
tr: Yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wajʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyā

ar: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
en: (7) [He was told],[810] "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
enNotes: [810]- By Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) through the angels.
tr: Yāzakariyyā innā nubashshiruka bighulāminismuhū yaḥyā lam najʿal lahū min qablu samiyyā

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
en: (8) He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
tr: Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmuw wakānatimraʾatī ʿāqiraw waqad balaghtu minal-kibari ʿitiyyā

ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
en: (9) [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"
tr: Qāla kadhālik, qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinuw waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayʾā

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
en: (10) [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."[811]
enNotes: [811]- i.e., without illness or defect.
tr: Qāla rabbijʿal lī āyah, qāla āyatuka allā tukalliman-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyā

ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
en: (11) So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.
tr: Fakharaja ʿalā qawmihī minal-miḥrābi faʾawḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū bukrataw waʿashiyyā

ar: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
en: (12) [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
tr: Yāyaḥyā khudhil-kitāba biquwwah, waʾātaynāhul-ḥukma ṣabiyyā

ar: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
en: (13) And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
tr: Waḥanānam mil ladunnā wazakāh, wakāna taqiyyā

ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
en: (14) And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
tr: Wabarram biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyā

ar: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
en: (15) And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
tr: Wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yubʿathu ḥayyā

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
en: (16) And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
tr: Wadhkur fil-kitābi maryam, idhintabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyā

ar: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
en: (17) And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
tr: Fattakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijābā, faʾarsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamaththala lahā basharan sawiyyā

ar: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
en: (18) She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."
tr: Qālat innī aʿūdhu bir-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyā

ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًا زَكِيًّا
en: (19) He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
tr: Qāla innamā ana rasūlu rabbik, liʾahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyā

ar: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
en: (20) She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
tr: Qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmuw walam yamsasnī basharuw walam aku baghiyyā

ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
en: (21) He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"
tr: Qāla kadhālik, qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyin, walinajʿalahū āyatal lin-nāsi waraḥmatam minnā, wakāna amram maqḍiyyā

ar: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
en: (22) So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
tr: Faḥamalathu fantabadhat bihī makānan qaṣiyyā

ar: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
en: (23) And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
tr: Faʾajāʾahal-makhāḍu ilā jidhʿin-nakhlah, qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyam mansiyyā

ar: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
en: (24) But he[812] called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
enNotes: [812]- There is a difference of opinion among scholars as to whether "he" refers to the baby or to the angel.
tr: Fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyā

ar: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
en: (25) And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
tr: Wahuzzī ilayki bijidhʿin-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyā

ar: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
en: (26) So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
tr: Fakulī washrabī waqarrī ʿaynā, faʾimmā tarayinna minal-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lir-raḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallimal-yawma insiyyā

ar: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
en: (27) Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
tr: Faʾatat bihī qawmahā taḥmiluh, qālū yāmaryamu laqad jiʾti shayʾan fariyyā

ar: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
en: (28) O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
tr: Yā ukhta hārūna mā kāna abūkimraʾa sawʾiw wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyā

ar: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
en: (29) So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
tr: Faʾashārat ilayh, qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fil-mahdi ṣabiyyā

ar: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
en: (30) [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
tr: Qāla innī ʿabdullāh, ātāniyal-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyā

ar: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
en: (31) And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
tr: Wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kunt, waʾawṣānī biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāti mā dumtu ḥayyā

ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
en: (32) And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
tr: Wabarram biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyā

ar: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
en: (33) And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
tr: Was-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulittu wayawma amūtu wayawma ubʿathu ḥayyā

ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
en: (34) That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
tr: Dhālika ʿīsabnu maryam, qawlal-ḥaqqil-ladhī fīhi yamtarūn

ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
en: (35) It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He![813] When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
enNotes: [813]- i.e., far removed is He from any such need.
tr: Mā kāna lillāhi ay yattakhidha miw waladin subḥānah, idhā qaḍā amran faʾinnamā yaqūlu lahū kun fayakūn

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
en: (36) [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
tr: Waʾinnallāha rabbī warabbukum faʿbudūh, hādhā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm

ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
en: (37) Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
tr: Fakhtalafal-aḥzābu mim baynihim, fawaylul lilladhīna kafarū mim mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīm

ar: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (38) How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
tr: Asmiʿ bihim waʾabṣir yawma yaʾtūnanā lākiniẓ-ẓālimūnal-yawma fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (39) And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded;[814] and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
enNotes: [814]- i.e., "judged" or "accomplished."
tr: Waʾandhirhum yawmal-ḥasrati idh quḍiyal-amr, wahum fī ghaflatiw wahum lā yuʾminūn

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
en: (40) Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
tr: Innā naḥnu narithul-arḍa waman ʿalayhā waʾilaynā yurjaʿūn

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
en: (41) And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
tr: Wadhkur fil-kitābi ibrāhīm, innahū kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyā

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
en: (42) [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
tr: Idh qāla liʾabīhi yā abati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yubṣiru walā yughnī ʿanka shayʾā

ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
en: (43) O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
tr: Yā abati innī qad jāʾanī minal-ʿilmi mā lam yaʾtika fattabiʿnī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyā

ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّا
en: (44) O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
tr: Yā abati lā taʿbudish-shayṭān, innash-shayṭāna kāna lir-raḥmāni ʿaṣiyyā

ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّا
en: (45) O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
tr: Yā abati innī akhāfu ay yamassaka ʿadhābum minar-raḥmāni fatakūna lish-shayṭāni waliyyā

ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
en: (46) [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
tr: Qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yā ibrāhīm, laʾil lam tantahi laʾarjumannaka wahjurnī maliyyā

ar: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
en: (47) [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you.[815] I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
enNotes: [815]- Meaning "You are secure" or "I will not harm you."
tr: Qāla salāmun ʿalayk, saʾastaghfiru laka rabbī, innahū kāna bī ḥafiyyā

ar: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
en: (48) And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke[816] my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
enNotes: [816]- i.e., worship.
tr: Waʾaʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūnillāhi waʾadʿū rabbī, ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāʾi rabbī shaqiyyā

ar: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
en: (49) So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
tr: Falammaʿtazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūnillāhi wahabnā lahū isḥāqa wayaʿqūb, wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyā

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
en: (50) And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
tr: Wawahabnā lahum mir raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣidqin ʿaliyyā

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
en: (51) And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.[817]
enNotes: [817]- A messenger (rasūl) is one who was charged by Allāh to reform society. A prophet (nabī) is one who received revelation from Allāh, the latter being more numerous than the former.
tr: Wadhkur fil-kitābi mūsā, innahū kāna mukhlaṣaw wakāna rasūlan nabiyyā

ar: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّا
en: (52) And We called him from the side of the mount[818] at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
enNotes: [818]- Mount Sinai.
tr: Wanādaynāhu min jānibiṭ-ṭūril-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyā

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
en: (53) And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
tr: Wawahabnā lahū mir raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyā

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
en: (54) And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
tr: Wadhkur fil-kitābi ismāʿīl, innahū kāna ṣādiqal-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyyā

ar: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
en: (55) And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
tr: Wakāna yaʾmuru ahlahū biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāh, wakāna ʿinda rabbihī marḍiyyā

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
en: (56) And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
tr: Wadhkur fil-kitābi idrīs, innahū kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyā

ar: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
en: (57) And We raised him to a high station.
tr: Warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyā

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
en: (58) Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna anʿamallāhu ʿalayhim minan-nabiyyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥ, wamin dhurriyyati ibrāhīma waʾisrāʾīl, wamimman hadaynā wajtabaynā, idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātur-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadaw wabukiyyā

ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
en: (59) But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil[819] -
enNotes: [819]- Described as a valley in Hell or may be rendered "the consequence of error."
tr: Fakhalafa mim baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿuṣ-ṣalāta wattabaʿush-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyā

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
en: (60) Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
tr: Illā man tāba waʾāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan faʾulāʾika yadkhulūnal-jannata walā yuẓlamūna shayʾā

ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
en: (61) [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.[820]
enNotes: [820]- Literally, "that to which all will come."
tr: Jannāti ʿadninil-latī waʿadar-raḥmānu ʿibādahū bil-ghayb, innahū kāna waʿduhū maʾtiyyā

ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
en: (62) They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
tr: Lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāmā, walahum rizquhum fīhā bukrataw waʿashiyyā

ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
en: (63) That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.
tr: Tilkal-jannatul-latī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyā

ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
en: (64) [Gabriel said],[821] "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
enNotes: [821]- In answer to the Prophet's wish that Gabriel would visit him more often.
tr: Wamā natanazzalu illā biʾamri rabbik, lahū mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyā

ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
en: (65) Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
tr: Rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā faʿbudhu waṣṭabir liʿibādatih, hal taʿlamu lahū samiyyā

ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
en: (66) And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
tr: Wayaqūlul-insānu aʾidhā mā mittu lasawfa ukhraju ḥayyā

ar: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
en: (67) Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
tr: Awalā yadhkurul-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayʾā

ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
en: (68) So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.[822]
enNotes: [822]- i.e., fallen on their knees from terror or dragged there unwillingly on their knees.
tr: Fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wash-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyā

ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا
en: (69) Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
tr: Thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalar-raḥmāni ʿitiyyā

ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
en: (70) Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
tr: Thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bil-ladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyā

ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
en: (71) And there is none of you except he will come to it.[823] This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
enNotes: [823]- i.e., be exposed to it. However, the people of Paradise will not be harmed thereby.
tr: Waʾim minkum illā wāriduhā, kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatmam maqḍiyyā

ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
en: (72) Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
tr: Thumma nunajjil-ladhīnattaqaw wanadharuẓ-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyā

ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
en: (73) And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"[824]
enNotes: [824]- In regard to worldly interests.
tr: Waʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qālal-ladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyul-farīqayni khayrum maqāmaw waʾaḥsanu nadiyyā

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
en: (74) And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
tr: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthaw wariʾyā

ar: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
en: (75) Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
tr: Qul man kāna fiḍ-ḍalālati falyamdud lahur-raḥmānu maddā, ḥattā idhā raʾaw mā yūʿadūna immal-ʿadhāba waʾimmas-sāʿah, fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrum makānaw waʾaḍʿafu jundā

ar: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
en: (76) And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord[825] for reward and better for recourse.
enNotes: [825]- i.e., in the sight or evaluation of Allāh.
tr: Wayazīdullāhul-ladhīnahtadaw hudā, wal-bāqiyātuṣ-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawābaw wakhayrum maraddā

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
en: (77) Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
tr: Afaraʾaytal-ladhī kafara biʾāyātinā waqāla laʾūtayanna mālaw wawaladā

ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
en: (78) Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
tr: Aṭṭalaʿal-ghayba amittakhadha ʿindar-raḥmāni ʿahdā

ar: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
en: (79) No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
tr: Kallā, sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahū minal-ʿadhābi maddā

ar: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
en: (80) And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions,[826] and he will come to Us alone.
enNotes: [826]- Instead of giving him wealth and children in the Hereafter, Allāh will take from him those he had in worldly life at the time of his death.
tr: Wanarithuhū mā yaqūlu wayaʾtīnā fardā

ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
en: (81) And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
tr: Wattakhadhū min dūnillāhi ālihatal liyakūnū lahum ʿizzā

ar: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
en: (82) No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
tr: Kallā, sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddā

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
en: (83) Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
tr: Alam tara annā arsalnash-shayāṭīna ʿalal-kāfirīna taʾuzzuhum azzā

ar: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
en: (84) So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.[827]
enNotes: [827]- Of breaths, of days, or of evil deeds.
tr: Falā taʿjal ʿalayhim, innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddā

ar: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا
en: (85) On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
tr: Yawma naḥshurul-muttaqīna ilar-raḥmāni wafdā

ar: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
en: (86) And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
tr: Wanasūqul-mujrimīna ilā jahannama wirdā

ar: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
en: (87) None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.[828]
enNotes: [828]- Not to worship other than Him.
tr: Lā yamlikūnash-shafāʿata illā manittakhadha ʿindar-raḥmāni ʿahdā

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا
en: (88) And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
tr: Waqāluttakhadhar-raḥmānu waladā

ar: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
en: (89) You have done an atrocious thing.
tr: Laqad jiʾtum shayʾan iddā

ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
en: (90) The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
tr: Takādus-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna minhu watanshaqqul-arḍu watakhirrul-jibālu haddā

ar: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا
en: (91) That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
tr: An daʿaw lir-raḥmāni waladā

ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
en: (92) And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
tr: Wamā yambaghī lir-raḥmāni ay yattakhidha waladā

ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًا
en: (93) There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
tr: In kullu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātir-raḥmāni ʿabdā

ar: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
en: (94) He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
tr: Laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddā

ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
en: (95) And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
tr: Wakulluhum ātīhi yawmal-qiyāmati fardā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
en: (96) Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.[829]
enNotes: [829]- From Himself and from among each other.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumur-raḥmānu wuddā

ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
en: (97) So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
tr: Faʾinnamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashshira bihil-muttaqīna watundhira bihī qawmal luddā

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
en: (98) And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
tr: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarn, hal tuḥissu minhum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rikzā
